title: Diagram model
description: The format-neutral model the diagram-architect produces and every renderer skill (Mermaid, draw.io, Gliffy) consumes. Adding a new output format means adding a skill that reads this model — nothing upstream changes.

title.description: Human title of the diagram and its view, e.g. 'Checkout flow — container view'. Sentence case, no trailing punctuation.

summary.description: Two or three plain sentences describing the system, written to the writing-style bar (no AI tells). Used as a caption / doc paragraph.

kind.description: The view being drawn. Renderers map this to a concrete diagram type.

groups.description: Optional containers (a cloud, a bounded context, a subsystem).

parent.description: id of an enclosing group, for nesting

label.description: Real name of the thing. Sentence case, no trailing punctuation.

group.description: id of the group this node sits in

role.description: Semantic role — drives consistent, role-based styling across formats.

tech.description: Canonical technology slug used to resolve an icon, e.g. 'postgresql', 'kafka', 'react', 'aws-lambda'. See tech-stack-icons.

icon.description: Resolved icon token: an Iconify id like 'logos:postgresql' for Mermaid, or a path to a rasterized PNG for draw.io/Gliffy. Filled by tech-stack-icons; may be omitted.

label.description: A verb or protocol/noun — 'writes to', 'gRPC', 'publishes order.created'. A few words, keeps routing clean.

kind.description: sync = solid arrow, async = dashed arrow, data = open line.

fromSide.description: optional port hint for aligned, orthogonal routing
